ELNK.description: Elastic Link (ELNK). The LINK type selects which fields apply: GEN uses R_S/SDR (6-component), TENS/COMP use SDR[0], MULTI LINEAR uses DIR/MLFC/DRENDI, RAIL INTERACT uses DIR/RLFC, while RIGID and SADDLE need no extra stiffness fields.

BNGR_NAME.description: Boundary group name to assign this elastic link to. Empty string means no group.

LINK.description: Elastic link sub-option/type. Case-insensitive. GEN=General, RIGID=Rigid, TENS=Tension-only, COMP=Compression-only, 'MULTI LINEAR'=Multi-Linear, SADDLE=Saddle, 'RAIL INTERACT'=Rail Track Interaction.

R_S.description: [LINK=GEN] Rigid/fixed flags per DOF [SDx, SDy, SDz, SRx, SRy, SRz]; true = rigid for that DOF.

SDR.description: Spring stiffness values [SDx, SDy, SDz, SRx, SRy, SRz]. [LINK=GEN] all 6 components are used (must be supplied). [LINK=TENS|COMP] only SDR[0] (axial stiffness) is used (must be supplied).

bSHEAR.description: Shear spring location flag. Applies to translational shear directions (Dy, Dz) and rotational (Ry, Rz).

DR.description: Distance ratios from End I for shear spring location [DRy, DRz], each 0.0-1.0.

DIR.description: [LINK=MULTI LINEAR|RAIL INTERACT] Direction index for the function-based behavior.

RLFC.description: [LINK=RAIL INTERACT] Rail-track interaction function ID number.

DRENDI.description: [LINK=MULTI LINEAR] Distance ratio from End I (0.0-1.0).
